description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseReferenceRange' that serves as a base for reference range entities in the OpenMRS project. It includes properties for various high and low reference values, their getters and setters, and is annotated for ORM and auditing purposes.

classes.name: BaseReferenceRange
classes.description: An abstract class representing reference range data with fields for high and low absolute, critical, and normal values, extending 'BaseOpenmrsObject' and annotated for persistence and auditing.

methods.name: getHiAbsolute
methods.description: Returns the high absolute value of the reference range.

methods.name: setHiAbsolute
methods.description: Sets the high absolute value of the reference range.

methods.name: getHiCritical
methods.description: Returns the high critical value of the reference range.

methods.name: setHiCritical
methods.description: Sets the high critical value of the reference range.

methods.name: getHiNormal
methods.description: Returns the high normal value of the reference range.

methods.name: setHiNormal
methods.description: Sets the high normal value of the reference range.
